step-1.text: Flip the top onto something soft, underside up. Pre-drilled holes should be facing you.

step-2.text: Screw a mounting plate onto each corner, four screws each, using the pre-drilled holes. These are what the legs twist into.

count-2.text: This step uses 4 mounting plates and 16 screws.

step-3.text: Twist on the first two legs, clockwise, until they are snug and straight. Hand tight is right.

step-4.text: And the last two. Check they all stand straight.

step-5.text: Screw a support bar between the front and back leg on each side. They stop the desk swaying when you type.

count-5.text: This step uses 2 support bars and 4 screws.

step-6.text: With a helper, turn it right side up. Lift it, don't pivot on the legs, or they can snap off.

count-6.text: Nothing new this step. Just you and the frame.

done.text: Done. Your 71" DESK computer desk is built. Give it a proud little pat.
